sh-ident: official env adds NODE_PATH=<official install deps dir> and empty __CURSOR_SANDBOX_ENV_RESTORE (bundle/sandbox artifacts); not mimicked
cwd-save: SECURITY: official exit.cwd keeps only the first line of a newline-containing cwd; ours reports the full path
cwd-check: SECURITY: official executes the 2nd line of a newline-containing cwd on the next call (injection); ours does not
multicwd: SECURITY: same newline-cwd truncation as cwd-save
cwd-next: SECURITY: official runs 'break' injected from the previous cwd; ours does not
path-save: official dump needs external grep; with PATH=/nonexistent it fails (stderr) and keeps old state. Ours dumps with builtins only and commits atomically
path-read: consequence of path-save: official LAST=unset (old state), ours LAST=x (complete new state); functions/aliases preserved in both
